section_1.title: Prerequisite: The Area Interpretation of Determinants
section_1.content: Briefly explain that the determinant of a 2x2 matrix represents the signed area of the parallelogram formed by the column vectors. Introduce the visual concept of scaling space.
section_1.example: Visualizing a square defined by vectors (1,0) and (0,1) transforming into a skewed parallelogram with area |det(A)|.

section_2.title: Framing the Linear System
section_2.content: Represent the system Ax = b as a vector equation: x1*v1 + x2*v2 = b. Explain that solving for x1 and x2 means finding how much of vector v1 and vector v2 we need to reach the 'target' b.
section_2.example: A robot arm with two segments (v1, v2) trying to reach a target point 'b' in a 2D plane.

section_3.title: Geometric Substitution (The Cramer's Rule Logic)
section_3.content: Show that replacing one column of the matrix with the vector 'b' creates a new parallelogram. Explain that the ratio of the area of this new parallelogram to the original is exactly the scalar value of x1.
section_3.example: Swapping v1 with the target vector 'b' creates a new shape. If the area of this new shape is double the original, then x1 must be 2.

section_4.title: Visual Synthesis and Conclusion
section_4.content: Summarize that Cramer's Rule is simply comparing 'areas'. Highlight that x1 = det(A1)/det(A) and x2 = det(A2)/det(A) provides a global view of scaling transformation.
section_4.example: A 'Scaling Gauge' animation showing the original unit parallelogram vs. the Cramer-substituted parallelograms as the system solves for 'b'.

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=20, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite: The Area Interpretation of Determinants", 
                          ["The determinant measures the signed area of a parallelogram.", 
                           "Unit squares transform into areas scaled by the determinant.", 
                           "This scaling factor is our fundamental geometric tool."])
        
        # Vectors
        v_i = Arrow(ORIGIN, RIGHT * 1.5, color="#FF6347")
        v_j = Arrow(ORIGIN, UP * 1.5, color="#4682B4")
        
        # Parallelogram
        parallelogram = Polygon(ORIGIN, v_i.get_end(), v_i.get_end() + v_j.get_end(), v_j.get_end(), 
                                fill_opacity=0.3, fill_color="#FFFACD", stroke_color=WHITE)
        
        # Labels
        det_label = MathTex(r"\det(A)", color=WHITE)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(v_i), FadeIn(v_j), FadeIn(parallelogram))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFD700")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.place_at_grid(det_label, "B5")
        self.play(FadeIn(det_label))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFD700")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Transform animation
        new_v_i = Arrow(ORIGIN, RIGHT * 2 + UP * 0.5, color="#FF6347")
        new_v_j = Arrow(ORIGIN, LEFT * 0.5 + UP * 2, color="#4682B4")
        new_para = Polygon(ORIGIN, new_v_i.get_end(), new_v_i.get_end() + new_v_j.get_end(), new_v_j.get_end(), 
                           fill_opacity=0.3, fill_color="#FFFACD", stroke_color=WHITE)
        
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(v_i, new_v_i), 
                  ReplacementTransform(v_j, new_v_j), 
                  ReplacementTransform(parallelogram, new_para))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FFD700")
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject
